title: Wi-Fi: $(nmcli -t -f ACTIVE,SSID,BARS dev wifi | grep '^yes' | cut -d: -f2- | tr ':' ' ' | grep -v '^$' || echo 'Not connected')

menu.title: Public IP: $(curl -s --max-time 4 api.ipify.org || echo 'no internet')$(nmcli -t -f NAME,TYPE con show --active | grep -q ':vpn$' && echo ' (VPN active)')
LAN: $(hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1 | grep -v '^$' || echo 'no connection')$(ip route | grep default | cut -d' ' -f3 | grep -v '^$' | sed 's/^/ via /')

command.monitor: rfkill list wifi | grep 'Soft blocked: no'
